scientific_integrity: General Markov-modulated covariance/moment formulae and the stationary Gaussian mixture are prior knowledge, explicitly acknowledged. The inverse iff family and exact cumulant contrast are evaluated as the candidate finding.
scientific_limitations: Population stationary time-lag position covariance only; two strictly positive distinct stiffnesses, finite positive Markov switch rates and independent Brownian noise. No finite-sample power result or global publication-priority certificate.
title: A complete equilibrium-covariance camouflage manifold for a switching harmonic trap
